claim: After removing one total-quality factor g, pretraining-mixture response has exactly one reproducible tradeoff factor h, and validation objectives select mixtures along the resulting one-dimensional dial.
scope: LLM pretraining data mixing; public-result L0 analysis only

randomness.seed_rule: little-endian uint64 from the first 8 bytes of SHA256('ONEDIAL-V1:' + label)

common_estimator.response_transform: lower-is-better task loss, centered and divided by fit-split task standard deviation with ddof=1
common_estimator.rank1_peeling: fit rank-1 OLS response operator on the opposite SHA256 row fold and subtract its held-out prediction; stack held-out residuals before estimating h

A.name: multiplicative-zero-replacement ilr
A.closure: replace each zero by delta and multiply positive entries by (1-k*delta)/positive_sum before Helmert ilr

B.name: zero-safe Hellinger
B.map: sqrt(closed_weights) times the transposed Helmert basis

common_estimator.operator: unregularized OLS with intercept after fit-split centering; SVD is taken on the task-by-coordinate coefficient operator
common_estimator.significant_residual_dimension: For each ordered residual singular value j, compute p_j=(1+count(s_j_perm>=s_j_obs))/(1+999); apply Holm at familywise alpha=0.01 over all residual indices and count the longest leading sequence for which every adjusted test rejects.
common_estimator.bootstrap_alignment: Within each original SHA fold, resample rows once with replacement, refit the complete cross-fitted estimator, and sign-align h to the point estimate; no result of a bootstrap replicate is bootstrapped again.
common_estimator.task_loading_orientation: orient g so median task loading is positive; orient h by the question-specific frozen anchor
common_estimator.invalidity: nonfinite cells, response scale below floor, deficient required design rank, or insufficient rows returns inconclusive and forbids estimator substitution

Q1.title: Synthetic calibration including structural zeros

interior_weight_generator.domain_count: m from the corresponding Olmix swarm
interior_weight_generator.row_count: finite weight-row count n_m from the corresponding unmodified Olmix ratios table
interior_weight_generator.draw_scope: fresh independent n_m-by-m matrix for each phase, m, interior scenario, and zero-based synthetic replicate; never used by structural-zero scenarios
interior_weight_generator.seed_rule: little-endian uint64 from the first 8 bytes of SHA256('ONEDIAL-V2:Q1-interior-weights:' + phase_seed_namespace + ':m=' + decimal(m) + ':scenario=' + scenario + ':replicate=' + decimal(zero_based_replicate_index))

truth.structural_zero_generator: g and h are linear in the zero-safe Hellinger coordinates of the unmodified design

Q1.pipeline_selection: Evaluate A and B on discovery only; choose A if it passes every discovery condition, otherwise choose B if B passes every condition; do not inspect confirmation until selection is frozen. Confirmation evaluates only the selected pipeline.
Q1.detector: Use the exact Q2 permutation p-value and Holm significant-dimension rule in every synthetic replicate; synthetic Monte Carlo replicates supply calibration uncertainty and are not bootstrap samples.
Q1.falsify: The selected pipeline misses any confirmation support condition in either confirmation design.
Q1.inconclusive: Neither pipeline passes discovery, or a synthetic design cannot satisfy its declared rank and finite-value gates.
Q1.death_branch: If Q1 is falsified or inconclusive, Q2-Q5 are recorded as inconclusive_by_Q1 and no real outcome table is analyzed.

Q2.title: Residual Olmix spectrum after peeling g
Q2.task_set: finite intersection of official task columns across all four Olmix designs, frozen before fitting
Q2.significance_null: independently permute each task's cross-fitted residual rows, add the fixed cross-fitted g prediction, and refit the full estimator
Q2.falsify: A valid discovery or confirmation design has no significant h, more than three significant residual dimensions, or misses any registered effect/stability condition.
Q2.inconclusive: A validity gate fails, or Q1-selected Hellinger g does not clear the H015-g alignment audit.
Q2.death_branch: A discovery failure quarantines confirmation; a scientific falsification sets Q4 and Q5 to falsified_by_Q2 because their dial is undefined, while Q3 may still run as an external-axis audit.

Q3.title: External task-loading replication and polarity

confirmation.regmix: official 60M and 1B test mixture/loss tables, reported separately

polarity.exact_task_anchor: mmlu_macro minus mean(arc_easy, hellaswag) must be positive
polarity.macro_anchor: code minus mean(web, wiki) must be positive

data_transforms.olmix: official lower-is-better BPB, with MMLU subtasks macro-averaged before task standardization
data_transforms.regmix: official lower-is-better validation loss; macro members are averaged before task standardization
data_transforms.datadecide_tasks: at the maximum released step per recipe/model/task/seed, use -log(max(correct_prob_per_char,1e-12)); average transformed losses over seeds, center recipes within each model size, and represent recipe by a fixed categorical one-hot design
data_transforms.datadecide_perplexity: at the maximum released step per recipe/model-size/seed, use log(perplexity); average transformed losses over seeds, form frozen macro targets, center recipes within each model size, and use the same categorical one-hot design

Q3.falsify: All artifacts and validity gates pass, but either bridge misses any confirmation cosine, sign, existence, or residual-energy threshold.
Q3.inconclusive: The pinned DataDecide task artifact is unavailable/incompatible, fewer than all frozen bridge targets are present, or a polarity anchor is numerically undefined.
Q3.agent_added_scope_guard: The exact-task and macro-target bridges are reported separately; no rotation, CCA, learned task matching, or claim of identical h(w) input coordinates is allowed.

Q4.title: Validation-objective optima collapse to a one-dimensional dial curve
Q4.dial: theta_v = atan2(v dot b, v dot a), with a and b frozen from the source design

curve.model: coordinate-wise cubic B-spline of oracle mixture on theta

Q4.shuffle_control: hold g fixed; independently permute every task's residual across oracle-target mixtures; recompute oracle selections and the frozen-form curve
Q4.falsify: A valid discovery or confirmation split misses any curve, shuffle, diversity, or dial-span condition.
Q4.inconclusive: The objective halves are too small, oracle ties exceed numerical tolerance 1e-10 without a unique hash tie-break, or Q2 supplies no valid dial.
Q4.agent_added_discrete_oracle_guard: The shuffle margin, unique-mixture gate, and held-out objective split must all pass so repeated finite-table argmins cannot manufacture a curve.

Q5.title: Few-point retrospective selection using frozen g and h
Q5.pilot_selection: deterministic farthest-first traversal in the Q1-selected mixture coordinates, initialized by the row nearest uniform; ties use SHA256 row ID
Q5.onedial_fit: freeze source-design task loadings a,b; estimate target-table task intercept from pilots, project pilot residuals onto a,b, fit two unregularized affine score maps, and predict every nonpilot candidate
Q5.objective_set: the same frozen 512 validation objectives as Q4
Q5.regret: (selected objective loss - oracle candidate loss) divided by the candidate objective-loss IQR; nonpositive numerical values are clipped to zero
Q5.falsify: A valid discovery or confirmation target misses any near-optimality, noninferiority, attribution, or candidate-support condition.
Q5.inconclusive: A pilot design is rank deficient, a target IQR is at most 1e-08, or a frozen source loading is unavailable.
Q5.agent_added_attribution_control: Independently permute a and b over tasks before fitting; One-Dial must beat this scrambled-loading control by the registered regret margins.
Q5.scope_guard: This is retrospective public-table observation efficiency, not evidence from newly trained models or target-scale transfer.

overall_verdict.SURVIVED: Q1-Q5 are supported and Q2 agent_added_exact_one passes.
overall_verdict.PARTIAL: No Q1-Q4 question is falsified, but at least one question is inconclusive, Q5 is falsified, or Q2 passes dimension<=3 while agent_added_exact_one fails.
overall_verdict.KILLED: Any of Q1-Q4 is falsified, including falsified_by_dependency.

mutation_policy: After Act I confirmation, thresholds and methods are immutable. A defect is appended to EXPERIMENTS.md and that question stops; no silent repair, fallback estimator, or outcome-conditioned reanalysis is allowed.

commands.execution: not authorized until explicit user confirmation of Act I
